scope: Exact proposals, not applied. Requires Map coverage labels for imported starts; no geometry approval.

proposals.claim: Living cultural identity has no supported extinction date. Existing start remains map coverage, not founding.

sources.locator: Outstanding Universal Value, Brief synthesis on continuing Gunditjmara relationship and knowledge transfer; 2010 cultural weir.
Gunditjmara Country, present custodianship and inherited aquaculture landscape.

proposals.claim: Maori remain living peoples. No supported extinction at 1914. Existing start remains map coverage, not founding.
proposals.caveat: Do not also extend maori and maoris snapshots into three simultaneous cultural records. Canonical identity reconciliation and geometry audit remain open.

proposals.claim: 1810 unification and 1893 overthrow support an explicitly named unified-monarchy phase. Clear fell until the actual Provisional Government recipient exists.

sources.locator: Narrative paragraphs beginning In 1810 and Supported by John Stevens, identifying January 17, 1893; paragraph on proclamation of Provisional Government.
Opening paragraph: overthrow and provisional government; second paragraph separates 1895 restoration attempt.

proposals.caveat: This is a scoped phase, not a claim that the kingdom was first founded in 1810. Earlier Kamehameha state and island polities still need records. If that phase name is undesirable, retain start as unknown map coverage and only correct to1893.

blockedModernStateOverrides.reason: Do not redate to1970. Current narrative includes nineteenth/early-twentieth-century barkcloth and colonial labour as well as diaspora, so it cannot become solely a modern-state card. Existing from1878 also lies within colonial history. Create cultural-community and government-phase identities before assigning new dates.

Do not redate the existing broad cultural card to1962. It covers aiga, faasamoa, nineteenth-century Christianity and communities beyond independent Samoa. A modern-state record can start1962 only after scope separation.
Ancient sacred chiefly line, later executive dynasties and modern constitutional kingdom need distinct phases. Neither snapshot1000 nor1878 establishes those transitions.

navigationRequirement: A change in governing authority is a transition, not culture extinction. Link1893 to the Provisional Government,1894 to the Republic, and later US administration only at its own checked phase; never skip directly from monarchy to USA in1893.
